title: Eric O. Keosky-Smith: 'I've been evangelizing this amazing book'
summary: Keosky-Smith is a business development and growth strategist in Arizona. He replied to Eric's post quoting Steve Blank, reporting what he had run into at an event there.
blockquote: I've been evangelizing this amazing book. At an event in Arizona yesterday, I found out one of those I was talking to about it also said they received an investment and followed some of your structure for their company.
